title: Team 2151 Participates in the Bridging the Gap Parade
author: Monty Pythons
excerpt: Team 2151 members represented PMSA at the 2026 Bridging the Gap Parade, handing out candy, spreading positivity, and connecting with the local community.
bodyMarkdown:
On September 12, around 15 members of our team represented Proviso Mathematics and Science Academy at the 2026 Bridging the Gap Parade & Community Resource Fair.

The annual event brings together communities across Proviso Township to celebrate unity, culture, and community involvement. This year's parade traveled from Bellwood to Proviso East High School in Maywood before continuing with a community resource fair.

Throughout the parade, our team members walked the route, handed out candy, and helped spread positivity to those watching along the way. It was great to see how excited people were to interact with the team and support everyone participating in the event!

Thank you to all of the team members who came out to represent Team 2151 and PMSA. Events like Bridging the Gap give us an opportunity to support the communities around us and represent our team outside of competitions.
